decision: Omit frame pointers by default in the optional GCC-optimized host; retain --frame-pointers for profilers that need frame chains. This modest instruction reduction is not the 250k lines/s target or a new accepted whole-stage baseline.
source_revision: d1af201f (builder integration); the measured matching compiler/library snapshots are the earlier regex implementation, before recursive values and branch redirection.
configuration_provenance: The measured candidate used an in-process FLAGS override before integrating the explicit frame_pointers option. Its manifest records the actual omission flags for fresh training and final compilation. The maintained API and explicit frame-chain override are exercised by the full suite.

validation.scope: Full suite applicable to the matching pre-recursive source snapshot, plus the new explicit frame-pointer PGO/LTO mode. The recursive-values module and six newly ported upstream recursive/held-view fixtures are excluded because this source predates those features.
validation.artifact_proof: All twelve existing runtime kernels in default and release match exactly except equal-width immutable bundle prefixes. Fresh checksum executions are included; no new runtime speedup is claimed.

failed_profile_reuse: Final-only reuse was rejected by GCC coverage-location checks after relocation. Mapping original source locations still failed missing static-function profiles, including compiling the original read-only C inputs into new object paths. These failures are setup failures, not performance measurements. Checks remained fatal and the measured candidate trained afresh.
validation_harness_fix: The initial full run stopped after 5771 passes because the cross-host test combined the checkout compiler source (with new __box_new runtime dependencies) with the selected older bundle library. The test now rebuilds the selected immutable bundle source with its matching library; the rerun includes all three cross-host targets.
profiles: Six fresh training runs produced complete run summaries, accumulated 1 through 6, with 64 profiles each. Same source snapshot and training file hashes as the control. No original immutable bundle was modified.

compilation.sample_order: Alternating for two variants; rotating positions and direction for three or more.
compilation.cpu_time_definition: User + system CPU seconds for the compiler and its waited-for children; may exceed wall time with multiple emission workers.

artifact_proof.scope: One-sample correctness/artifact equivalence proof, not a runtime performance measurement. All twelve kernels in both modes match apart from equal-width immutable bundle paths.

limits: Native 64-bit host. Warm filesystem caches; one build per binary.
C graph uses flat edges and a handwritten map; Dewy uses per-node arrays and an insertion-ordered map.
String equality uses separately allocated payloads; C uses pointer/length pairs and libc memcmp, Dewy uses runtime strings.
Kernel times exclude input generation; wall times include the complete process.
Thread CPU timing excludes descheduling, but CPU frequency and cache contention still matter.

limitations: 4 passing and 3 inconclusive paired compilation comparisons, no established regression; no accepted baseline changes. Frame-chain inclusive profilers need --frame-pointers; existing debug names remain. Current recursive-language throughput still needs a newly built host.
